evidence_basis.operator_design_ruling: The anchor data must be DOCUMENT CONCATENATION read with hidden-state resets at the record separator — i.e. arbitrary-entry window cuts, NOT document-aligned whole books. Rationale on record: whole-book alignment overtrains document beginnings and never exercises mid-document state entry (a competence pretraining built via the pile's raw window cuts, and one the state-forking deployment demos depend on). The machinery already supports this: ndm/data/masked_sft_dataset.py has token-aligned reset_before masks (every record starts with a clean recurrent-state reset) and an explicit record-reset SFT mode — so a mid-book window-cut fragment is just a record and gets fresh-state arbitrary entry by construction. The mainmix-draws cohort already matches this design (scan-across fragments, window-edge fragments kept); ONLY the library cohort was re-rendered (v2).
evidence_basis.pivot_rationale: E1 stopped fail-closed at u384: late-arc behavioral oscillation — the model became tool-eager in wrong contexts (Stage-B 7/14 -> 10/14 -> 6/14 across u128/u256/u384; chat 1/3 -> 1/3 -> 0/3; the u128+u256-passing greeting failed at u384 with undeclared_pi_action — phantom tool calls on plain-chat prompts; retention held throughout at 1.52). The u384 forensics reading: emission-level dialect competition, dose-driven — not a retention failure. The E2 pivot therefore REBALANCES the tool-eager cohorts down (verified-raw-OH 15.01% -> 9.97% of targets, tooltalk 8.24% -> 4.99%) and folds in the long-document anchor cohorts (combined 19.64% of targets) that re-introduce the base pre-training distribution's raw long-form text — the distribution that formed the recurrent state dynamics, measured drifting +0.1665 nats (monotone on all 8 panel documents) from base y-form to v6.
